ghiChu: RA SOAT TOAN BO QUY TAC TINH TIEN PHONG HAT - ba cho thu sai tien, do bang cach goi thang ham tinh tien. (1) LUAT 127 - BLOCK PHUT AN VAO GOI GIO: goi 60 phut, khach hat 61 phut, quan dat block 30 phut thi thu 60.000d tien vuot thay vi 2.000d - vi block lam tron TONG so phut TRUOC khi tru phan goi, nen phan vuot bi doi len tron mot block

no con in "60 phut" cho nguoi hat 55 phut. Nay block chi ap cho phong tinh theo gio, dung ly le da chot cho gio toi thieu: goi la mot mon hang co so phut ghi tren no, lam tron so phut ay la doi mon hang. (2) LUAT 128 - BA MOC KHUNG GIO KHONG CO PHEP KIEM NAO: ba khoa quyet dinh gia cua MOI hoa don phong ma khong he co trong bang kiem gia tri - khong kiem khuon gio, khong kiem thu tu. Do duoc: khai sangTu 13:00 sangDen 09:00 thi 10h sang tinh GIO CHIEU va khung sang khong bao gio dung toi

khai chieuDen 12:00 < sangDen 13:00 thi 14h chieu tinh GIO TOI, tuc gia cao nhat - khong mot dong nao keu. Nay chan luc luu (ke ca khi chi sua MOT o, nho ghep voi gia tri dang luu trong CSDL), VA may chu ghi mot dong canh bao len hoa don khi gia tri bay da nam san tu truoc - chan luc ghi khong cham toi may da co gia tri bay. (3) LUAT 129 - PHU PHI QUA GIO NHAN DIEN BANG TEN: don ban theo goi ma hat vuot goi thi tien vuot da nam trong tien phong, cong them phu phi qua gio nua la thu hai lan. Phep chan ay nhan dien bang bieu thuc /qua gio|quá giờ|overtime/ tren TEN, nen dat ten "Them gio", "Phi ngoai goi" hay "Phat tre gio" la lot het. Mot hang rao khop theo nhan nguoi dung tu go thi doi ten la mat hang rao. Nay hoi mot O TICH rieng tren man Phu phi, va la anh chup luc ap nen sua quy tac thang sau khong lam doi hoa don da chot. Ban di tru 50 bat san o ay cho moi luat ma phep chan cu DANG bat duoc - khong the thi ban va sinh ra dung cai loi no di sua. Hai cho khac da do va thay DUNG: gio toi thieu khong an vao goi, va tien gio cac phong da gop duoc chot cung luc gop.
